svg.text: BED v8 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
Timber support: 50 mm deep x 40 mm high
1. Cut ONE laminated plywood panel 1587.2 x 1200 mm. It fits a single 4 x 8 sheet.
2. Use THREE narrow solid-timber battens 1507.2 x 50 x 40 mm, fixed to suitable wall
3. Fix the ONE laminated panel to the three battens; do not add another plywood layer.
4. No extra full-sheet plywood backing, foam, fabric or buttons. Upholstery can be added
